components.name: Sheet Label
components.description: Architectural drawing annotation that opens major sections; doubles as floor wayfinding.
components.css: .ds-sheet { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; margin-bottom: 2rem; } .ds-sheet .no { font: 500 0.8rem 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: #7A6240; } .ds-sheet .rule { width: 4.5rem; height: 1px; background: currentColor; opacity: 0.4; } .ds-sheet .title { font: 500 0.72rem 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #55534C; }

components.name: Finish Swatch
components.description: Circular material swatch for the cabin configurator; pressed state ringed in bronze.
components.css: .ds-swatch { width: 2.7rem; height: 2.7rem; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid rgba(22,23,27,0.34); background: linear-gradient(135deg, #A98E5F, #6E5334); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-swatch:hover { transform: scale(1.08); } .ds-swatch[aria-pressed="true"] { outline: 2px solid #A98E5F; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Finder Select (light field)
components.description: Paper-ground select inside the hairline solution-finder grid.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.45rem; padding: 1.1rem 1.2rem; background: #F4F1EB; } .ds-field label { font: 500 0.62rem 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #55534C; } .ds-field select { border: none; background: none; font: 500 1rem 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; color: #16171B; cursor: pointer; } .ds-field select:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #A98E5F; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-card { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: flex-end; min-height: 20rem; color: #F4F1EB; text-decoration: none; overflow: hidden; background: #141619; } .ds-card img { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; transition: transform 1.5s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-card:hover img { transform: scale(1.05); } .ds-card-body { position: relative; padding: 1.5rem; } .ds-card .k { font: 500 0.62rem 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #C2A878; } .ds-card h3 { font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; font-stretch: 118%; font-size: 1.5rem; margin-top: 0.5rem; } .ds-card .cta { display: inline-flex; gap: 0.5rem; margin-top: 0.95rem; font: 600 0.74rem 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #C2A878; }

components.name: Floor Indicator Rail
components.description: Signature elevator wayfinding: fixed mono floor buttons, current floor in bronze.
components.css: .ds-rail { position: fixed; left: 1.35rem; top: 50%; translate: 0 -50%; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.35rem; padding: 0.65rem 0.3rem; border: 1px solid rgba(22,23,27,0.16); background: rgba(244,241,235,0.82); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); } .ds-rail button { font: 400 0.66rem 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; color: #7D7A71; padding: 0.32rem 0.42rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-rail button:hover { color: #16171B; } .ds-rail .cur { color: #0F1013; background: #A98E5F; }

narrative.overview: The site reads like an architectural monograph devoted to vertical movement: floor-numbered sections, hairline rules, measurement ticks, and typography set with an engineer's restraint. Photography is cinematic; the interface around it stays nearly invisible. Premium quality comes from proportion, whitespace and material honesty — never from ornament. The page alternates bright architectural passages with dark cinematic ones like a building moving between day-lit floors and service cores; one champagne-bronze voice marks action and orientation, deliberately rationed.
keyCharacteristics: Graphite/warm-paper alternation with bronze as the single accent
Archivo expanded display against IBM Plex Sans body; Plex Mono reserved for measurement
Hairline 1px rules and floor-tick devices instead of boxes and cards-in-cards
Elevator metaphors made functional: floor indicator rail, door-panel reveals, descending scroll cue
Square corners everywhere; circles only for controls and swatches

rules.name: The Bronze Budget Rule
rules.body: Bronze covers ≤10% of any viewport. Its rarity is the luxury; if everything is accented, nothing is.

rules.name: The Alternation Rule
rules.body: Dark and bright sections alternate like a building's floors; never two consecutive sections of the same value without a change in density or scale.

rules.name: The Measurement Rule
rules.body: Plex Mono appears only where a drawing would annotate: floor numbers, dimensions, spec readouts, sheet labels. Never for sentences.

rules.name: The One Display Rule
rules.body: Display type is always Archivo expanded; no second display voice exists.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No resting shadows. Elevation appears only for true overlays.

dos: Do alternate dark and bright sections; the page is a building, not a scroll of cards.
Do use bronze for exactly one thing per view: the primary action or the orientation mark.
Do keep mono labels short — they annotate, they never speak.
Do let photography carry emotion; keep UI around it hairline-thin.
Do mark unverifiable content with the [CLIENT TO CONFIRM] treatment — integrity is part of the brand.
donts: Don't add radii, drop shadows, glass, gradient text or icon-card grids — the system's surfaces are flat and ruled.
Don't introduce a second accent colour or a decorative display face.
Don't use Plex Mono for body copy or buttons.
Don't cover sections with nested boxes; separation is whitespace + 1px rules.
Don't animate anything faster than --dur-fast (350ms) except the door wipe; motion is smooth, slow, precise.
